Removes the shared peer-service mapping from javaagent test defaults so mapped-only attributes no longer appear in default catalog output.

Explicit mapped profiles preserve coverage for legacy `peer.service` and preview `service.peer.name`. Removes redundant unmapped service-peer-only preview runs and their collection wiring while retaining meaningful RPC, unit-test, and feature-enabled coverage.
